name: manifest-reference-existence
title: The merge-gate preflight validates task context manifest references by shape only, never by existence
description: checkTrellisTaskContextManifests validates manifest row shape but never probes the filesystem, so an implement.jsonl / check.jsonl row naming a path that has never existed passes the merge-gate preflight. Trellis's own task.py validate already enforces existence (task_context.py::_validate_jsonl), so the two validators disagree and the permissive one is the one wired into the gate. Add existence checking, honour the type field for directory entries, and keep isTrellisTaskContextReference a pure shape predicate.
creator: sdelmas
